entities.summary: Justin Oliver Harper is an American professional basketball player who last played for Utsunomiya Brex of the Japanese B. League. Harper played professionally in the NBA for various teams, including the Orlando Magic, Detroit Pistons, and Philadelphia 76ers. He played college basketball for the University of Richmond.
